name: Circulating fluidized-bed boiler (CFB)
description: Solid-fuel boiler that burns particles in a circulating fluidized bed, recirculating the bed material through a cyclone so even difficult fuels — high-sulfur, high-ash, waste, biomass and refinery solids — burn cleanly at low furnace temperature with limestone capturing SOx in the furnace. Fluidized-bed steam generation for power and industrial steam where fuel flexibility and in-furnace desulfurization matter.

subtypes.name: Sumitomo SHI FW CFB
subtypes.description: high-efficiency multi-fuel CFB with bed material recirculated through a cyclone; up to 100% biomass or RDF streams and Flexi-Burn oxyfuel option

subtypes.name: B&W IR-CFB (internal recirculation)
subtypes.description: one- or two-drum top-supported design burning high-sulfur and high-ash fuels, gob and culm, with subcritical and supercritical applications

applications: thermal power stations on local and low-cost fuels
biomass and RDF power, including 100% biomass co-firing

notes: SOx capture in the furnace with limestone removes the traditional FGD system — useful where refineries scrub petcoke or high-sulfur solid firing. Bubbling fluidized-bed variants (BFB) sit in the same family: B&W states bottom-supported BFB up to 225,000 lb/h and top-supported 225,000-1,000,000 lb/h.
